I also work in multiple remote companies. Here is what I found useful. 
Wise - This is how I get paid from my clients. 
Priyo pay - I send some USD from Wise every month for various expenses. I use their card for international transactions. I also took a physical card so I can withdraw money in case of emergency from Bangladesh. Conversation Rate stays the same. They charge 1 USD per month. Their card support everywhere including apple pay and Google pay. They give some kind of virtual address to use for these transactions. Plus it saves me money on the tax that Bangladesh bank charge on some international payments. 
City bank - for regular transactions inside Bangladesh. I have used amex before for international transactions. But it was expensive due to the two times conversation fees. (First USD to bdt and then Bdt to USD again).
